title: clinopodium largiflorum
intro: Clinopodium largiflorum, commonly known as Chinese Clinopodium, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throat, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium largiflorum include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and promote sweating to reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
